print.me <- function(x, ...) {
  len <- min(nrow(x), 200)
  x[1:len, , drop = FALSE] |>
    kbl(digits = 2, align = "l", booktabs = TRUE) |>
    kable_styling(fixed_thead = TRUE) |>
    kable_paper("striped", 
                full_width = TRUE, 
                html_font = "Helvetica", 
                font_size = 12) |>
    row_spec(
      0, 
      color = "white", 
      background = "#9D2235", 
      font_size = 12) |>
    scroll_box(
      width = "700px", 
      height = "500px") |>
    asis_output()
}

registerS3method("knit_print", "data.frame", print.me)

```{r}
# Helper: safe gsub 
safe_gsub <- function(pattern, replacement, x, ...) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  gsub(pattern, replacement, x, ...)
}

# Helper: expand common English contractions

expand_contractions <- function(x) {
  # Order matters: specific forms before general n't rule
  x <- safe_gsub("won't",   "will not",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("can't",   "cannot",    x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("shan't",  "shall not", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("n't",     " not",      x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("'re",     " are",      x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("'ve",     " have",     x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("'ll",     " will",     x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("'d",      " would",    x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- safe_gsub("'m",      " am",       x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}


# Main cleaning function
peace_genie_pro_max <- function(
                                text_input       = my_text,
                                to_lower            = TRUE,
                                fix_encoding        = TRUE,
                                normalize_quotes    = TRUE,
                                remove_urls         = TRUE,
                                remove_emails       = TRUE,
                                remove_numbers      = TRUE,
                                preserve_roman      = TRUE,
                                split_hyphens       = TRUE,
                                keep_apostrophes    = TRUE,
                                expand_contractions = TRUE,
                                remove_stopwords    = FALSE,
                                stopword_lang       = "en",
                                lemmatize        = FALSE,
                                tokenize   = FALSE,
                                squash_whitespace   = TRUE,
                                verbose             = TRUE) {


  # 1. Input Validation
  
  if (missing(text_input)) {
    stop("No text input supplied.")
  }

  # Force character
  text_input <- as.character(text_input)

  # Track original NA positions
  na_count <- sum(is.na(text_input))

  # Replace NA safely
  text_input[is.na(text_input)] <- ""

  # Set and normalise encoding
  Encoding(text_input) <- "UTF-8"
  text_input           <- enc2utf8(text_input)
  text_input[is.na(text_input)] <- ""


  # 2. Fix Encoding Issues on PDF or Web Text

  if (fix_encoding) {
    text_input <- iconv(text_input, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
    text_input[is.na(text_input)] <- ""
  }


  # 3. Normalize Smart Quotes
  
  if (normalize_quotes) {
    text_input <- safe_gsub(
      "[\u2018\u2019\u02BC\u201B\uFF07\u0060\u00B4\u2032\u2035\u0091\u0092]",
      "'", text_input
    )
    text_input <- safe_gsub(
      "[\u201C\u201D\u201E\u2033]",
      "\"", text_input
    )
  }


  # 4. Protect Roman Numeral
  
   if (preserve_roman) {
    text_input <- safe_gsub(
      "\\b(M{0,4}(CM|CD|D?C{0,3})(XC|XL|L?X{0,3})(IX|IV|V?I{0,3}))\\b",
      " ROMAN_NUM ",
      text_input,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  }


  # 5. To Lower Case
  
  if (to_lower) text_input <- tolower(text_input)


  # 6. Remove Urls and Emails
  
  if (remove_urls)
    text_input <- safe_gsub("https?://\\S+|www\\.\\S+", " ", text_input)

  if (remove_emails)
    text_input <- safe_gsub(
      "\\b[[:alnum:]._%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}\\b",
      " ", text_input
    )


  # 7. Split Hyphens and Underscores
  
  if (split_hyphens) text_input <- safe_gsub("[-_]", " ", text_input)


  # 8. Remove numbers
  
  if (remove_numbers) text_input <- safe_gsub("[0-9]+", " ", text_input)


  # 9. Normalize any repeated punctuation and elongated characters
  

  text_input <- safe_gsub("([[:punct:]])\\1+", "\\1", text_input, perl = TRUE)
  text_input <- safe_gsub("(.)\\1{2,}",        "\\1", text_input, perl = TRUE)


  # 10. Expand Contractions
  
  if (expand_contractions) text_input <- expand_contractions(text_input)


  # 11. Punctuation COntrol
  
  if (keep_apostrophes) {
    text_input <- safe_gsub("'",        "APOSTOKEN", text_input, fixed = TRUE)
    text_input <- safe_gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ",     text_input)
    text_input <- safe_gsub("APOSTOKEN", "'",        text_input, fixed = TRUE)
  } else {
    text_input <- safe_gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ", text_input)
  }


  # 12. Removes Stopwords using quanteda's built-in lists

  if (remove_stopwords) {
    sw <- quanteda::stopwords(stopword_lang)
    text_input <- sapply(text_input, function(doc) {
      words <- unlist(strsplit(doc, " "))
      words <- words[words != ""]          # drop empty tokens
      paste(words[!words %in% sw], collapse = " ")
    }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  }

  # 13. Lemmatize
  
  if (lemmatize) {
    text_input <- textstem::lemmatize_strings(text_input)
  }

  # 14. Clean up Roman Numeral Placeholder
  
  if (preserve_roman) {
    text_input <- safe_gsub("roman_num", "", text_input, fixed = TRUE)
    # after lowercase step the placeholder becomes roman_num
  }


  # 15. Whitespsace Normalization
  
  if (squash_whitespace) {
    text_input <- safe_gsub("\\s+", " ", text_input)
    text_input <- trimws(text_input)
  }


  # 16. Verbose Cleaning Report
  
  if (verbose) {
    empty_after <- sum(trimws(text_input) == "")
    message(sprintf(
      "[peace_genie_pro_max] Cleaned %d string(s) | %d were NA | %d empty after cleaning",
      length(text_input),
      na_count,
      empty_after
    ))
  }

 # 17. Tokenize
  
  if (tokenize) {
    text_input <- quanteda::tokens(
      text_input,
      what            = "word",
      remove_punct    = FALSE,  # already handled above
      remove_numbers  = FALSE,  # already handled above
      remove_symbols  = TRUE,
      remove_url      = FALSE   # already handled above
    )
  }
  # 16. Return Clean Char Vector
  
  return(as.character(text_input))
}
```

## Demo Testing

```{r}
test <- c(
  "SECTION IV: You didn't say that!!!",
  NA,
  "Email: test@test.com --- PART XII",
  "   Weird     spacing   here   ",
  "Sooooo excited about this!!! Check http://example.com",
  "She won't can't shan't stop!!!"
)

peace_genie_pro_max(test)
```

## Demo: Stopword Removal Enabled

```{r}
peace_genie_pro_max(test, remove_stopwords = TRUE)

#remember lematization, and apostrophe in terms of possessive nouns or pronoun
```
